sources.label: Program application questions and English threshold

english.toefl: 105 iBT on program page (legacy scale); central minimum 4.5 for tests on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS 7 is a recommended minimum. Programs may require higher scores. English-medium degrees may exempt testing; applicants outside the listed countries should arrange a Registrar/Dean letter confirming English instruction. Program normally does not consider legacy iBT below 105 and prefers higher; no program-specific new-scale conversion stated. Confirm new-scale expectation.

applicationFee.note: Documented financial hardship: request through the application with an explanation and accepted financial-aid/FAFSA/CSS/unemployment/test-fee-reduction documentation. Recommended at least two weeks before deadline. International applicants should confirm documentation eligibility.

documents: College transcripts with certified English translations where needed
Four short answers: scientific motivation, research preparation, challenge overcome, and Brown fit (identify at least two faculty)
requirements.note: At least two recommendations should be from faculty at the current or most recently attended institution. Recommenders submit online; Interfolio not accepted. Official final transcripts required before matriculation. Prerequisites: intermediate calculus, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, programming, and at least one undergraduate chemistry and molecular biology course; exceptional strength may compensate for some gaps.

funding.note: Central doctoral support applies to domestic and foreign students, conditional on satisfactory academic progress; transfer-student funding may vary. Program explicitly supports all PhD students, including international students: stipend, tuition remission, health-services fee, health and dental insurance, including summers.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Current central program listing; older department FAQ dates are not substituted.

timeline.decisions: Program FAQ says review usually finishes by the end of February, with offers by March; no cycle year stated.
